The '''government''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hjaff]] was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==History==
After a long period of these various wars, the Tarc nations eventually ceased to fight one another and integrated into a single government, lead by a leader named the ''[[Keddek]]'' and a body of three continental leaders, and began space exploration in the surrounding [[Star system/Legends|systems]],<ref name="AE" /> and colonized twenty systems.<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|II|45|Hjaff}}</ref> The Tarc were horrified to discover [[Alien/Legends|alien]] life, but they interpreted such outsiders as a threat and immediately retreated and ceased all space exploration, leaving their colonized systems as a buffer between them and the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="AE" />

A [[Tarc—Imperial conflict|war]] broke out with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon after the two came into first contact and led their [[Navy/Legends|navy]], known as the [[Ivlacav Gourn]], to attack Imperial [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] entering [[Tarc domain|Tarc-controlled]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. This led to a number of skirmishes in all of which the Tarc were victorious.<ref name="AE" />

==Organization==
===Government===
{{Main|Keddek}}
It consisted of the unified governments of the independent nations that made up the planet prior to the unified governments formation. The government was isolationist and remained one of the few insular civilizations in the galaxy. It was led by an elected leader called the ''[[Keddek]]'' and three elected continental leaders who advised him. The ''Keddek'' was required to obey the [[Hjaff constitution]]. The constitution also provided for the three continental leaders to strip the Keddek of their position.<ref name="AE" />

===Military===
{{Main|Ivlacav Gourn}}
The [[Ivlacav Gourn]] was the military arm of the [[Tarc]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was used to protect the [[Tarc domain|Tarc territories]] from the encroaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] culture, perceived by the Tarc as corrupting.<ref name="AE" />
